items.name: Harold Clark - To the Members of the Board, pt.1
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: I'm leaving this audio log for my incompetent brothers and the esteemed members of the board at Clark, Clark, Clark & Associates.

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: This is Harold K. Clark, Jr. and I am currently locked in Vault-Tec's Vault 51 in the Appalachia region of West Virginia.

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: Since no one else had the balls, I took it upon myself and came to this Vault, but I've been locked in.

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: In here I'm known as "Clayton Ward," since someone was too stupid to show up - thanks for the free rent, moron!

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: I'm not sure what the situation is out there, but everything seemed fine before I got here...

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: I don't know if anything could bomb as bad as our profits last year!

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: Nuclear war might actually help you fools - great job running my father's company into the ground, by the way!

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: I've taken a good look at this place, and, honestly? Not impressed.

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: Sure, it's big, but that's what you get when you're working on Uncle Sam's dime, robbing the American people blind.

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: The Clarks built ourselves up from nothing and represent the actual American -- hard-working and not willing to quit!

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: But seriously, this Vault? Incredible. Nothing the nerds at the lab could do!

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: Listen, if you eggheads could do your jobs... It's incredible. Amazing, even!

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: Get this: there's this giant computer here and it's running this whole show by itself! Nobody pulling the strings, does it all on it's own! Amazing!

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: Gonna learn more and report back whenever possible. Howard...

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: I mean, Clayton Ward out.

items.name: Harold Clark - To the Members of the Board, pt.2
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: Hi, this is Harold. At this point, I expect I'm the only person on the board alive, otherwise someone... someone would have come for me.

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: God knows I won't be for long. This place... this place is like nothing we would have expected.

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: There was an explosion in here and it's like nothing ever happened.

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: I start digging around in ZAX's files just to see what's happening outside? Gone the next day. Gone. The files, the terminals, everything.

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: That thing... it's not a computer, it's more like a goddamn wizard! A god!

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: And, I just know it, ZAX has been pitting us against each other this whole time.

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: Thought no one would notice, that it was just some fun and games... then he started giving these maniacs guns!

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: What in god's name was Vault-Tec planning? Was this a trap? Did Vault-Tec lure me here? Most of us are dead!
*distant screams*

transcript.speaker: Reuben
transcript.text: Clayton! Get out here! Oh, you're gonna pay for taking my room!

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: Oh god, that lunatic is coming for me... ZAX gave him a gun and now he's after me...

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: H, Hey, you! Get away from me!

items.name: Helen Marks & Reuben Gill - 20780803
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Recording. Candidates Helen Marks and Reuben Gill. August 03, 2078.

transcript.speaker: Helen
transcript.text: ZAX, you're sure it's safe in here? I heard such a commotion and... oh my god.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Affirmative. This room is safe. All candidates in this room are deceased.

transcript.speaker: Helen
transcript.text: Wow... Carmen, Matthew, the Chambers'... all dead... what happened in here?

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Playing audio log.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth
transcript.text: YOU HARLOT! Matty isn't yours he's mine! MINE!

transcript.speaker: Carmen
transcript.text: *choking*

transcript.speaker: Matthew
transcript.text: You psycho, get off her!

transcript.speaker: Matthew
transcript.text: Carmen, Carmen... wake up, baby. Please, wake up...

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: Oh my god, Elizabeth... Hey, what are you doing with my Carmen!

transcript.speaker: Matthew
transcript.text: Get off me, just listen for a second... hey wait, put that down, don't-

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: Oh Carmen... Beth... how did this happen... I can't...

transcript.speaker: Helen
transcript.text: OK, ZAX, that's enough. I can't listen to that any more.

transcript.speaker: Reuben
transcript.text: Helen, you need any help... Jeez, what happened here?

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Request processed. Playing audio log.

transcript.speaker: Helen
transcript.text: No, ZAX, that's not necessary. Looks like a messed up case of a lover scorned.

transcript.speaker: Reuben
transcript.text: Wow, I had no idea this was going on. The Chambers seemed so perfect together, too. That's more food for us, at least.

transcript.speaker: Helen
transcript.text: That isn't funny, Reuben.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Candidate Reuben Gill is correct. Ration supply should be stable for the foreseeable future. Congratulations.

transcript.speaker: Helen
transcript.text: You're horrible, both of you! These people just died! I can't be here anymore, someone needs to clean this up.

transcript.speaker: Reuben
transcript.text: Wait, Helen! I'm sorry! Helen!

items.name: Joel & Elizabeth Chambers - 20780623
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Recording. Candidates Joel Chambers & Elizabeth Chambers. June 23, 2078.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Greetings, Joel Chambers. Good news. It appears there is only a minor fracture in your arm and it should heal quickly.

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: You know, I don't consider this an injury, I consider this a stepping stone towards the future.

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: If the American people know one thing, it's struggling. My father always said when "you suffer minor setbacks..."

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth
transcript.text: Minor setbacks? That's what you call showing off to that harlot?

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: Now, honey, you know Carmen is just a loyal constituent and, in these troubled times, it's important to reward your loyal supporters and, I have to make sure that everyone that supported me on the outside understands they're still protected here.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Very good. Elizabeth Chambers, have you been unwell? Your health seems to have decreased since your last checkup.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: I recommend additional health care. I would suggest you see candidate Matthew Johnston, he is a licensed personal trainer.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth
transcript.text: I have been a little tense lately...

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: I think a personal trainer is a great idea for you honey! I mean, we haven't had much personal time since we've come here and you've been getting a little...you know, impressions are very important. You understand.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth
transcript.text: Yes, ZAX, sure. I'll go see him right now. If you'll excuse me, JOEL.

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: Honey, wait! You know, ZAX, sometimes it seems like you're working against me.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: I am only concerned with selecting a suitable Overseer candidate.

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: So why do you keep on bringing up Carmen? You know how Beth feels about her...Jesus...

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: I do not know the extent of Elizabeth's feelings. I will ask her. Good night, candidate Joel Chambers.

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: Wait, ZAX, no, that's not what I meant!

items.name: Joel & Elizabeth Chambers - 20780803
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Recording. Candidates Joel Chambers and Elizabeth Chambers. August 3, 2078.

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: Jesus, Beth, what happened back there? Why didn't you pull the trigger? That woman was going to kill me! If Carmen wasn't there...

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth
transcript.text: What happened?! She was hungry, just like the rest of us! How could I kill someone in cold blood like that... this Vault has changed you, Joel.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Hello, Joel Chambers and Elizabeth Chambers. How are you this afternoon?

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: ZAX, what the hell is going on?! Are we running out of food? I thought we would be okay for years, it's only been 9 months!

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: And where did those guns come from?

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Unfortunately, ration supply...

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth
transcript.text: I can't believe you. What happened to the man I married? Asking me to kill someone... you know, Matthew was right about you.

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: Always bringing up that meathead... what does he mean to you, anyway? You'd better not be messing around behind my back again, we've talked about this...

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Excessive population has negatively affected ration supply...

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth
transcript.text: Oh, you're one to talk! I've seen you and that little whore sneaking off together, do you think I'm an idiot?

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: Don't talk about Carmen like that! You don't know what I've been through, always in the spotlight... Carmen... at least she understands the pressures of fame!

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Ration supply has decreased...

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth
transcript.text: FAME?! You were a STATE Senator, Joel, not President of the United States! Like you got yourself there anyway.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth
transcript.text: Life's a lot different when your father isn't around to fix all your problems!

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: Wow, Beth. Always pointing the finger at me... Well, what about you? What about you, Elizabeth?

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: Glad you called in those "favors" to get us stuck in here with these psychopaths!

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: I think I would have rather been blown to smithereens then spend the rest of my life in here with you!

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: ZAX, where's Carmen?! I cannot be stuck in here one more second with... HER!

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Locating Carmen Greene. Candidate Carmen Greene is currently...

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth
transcript.text: Glad to hear how you really feel, Joel. ZAX, where's Matt? Let him know I'm coming to see him.

transcript.speaker: Joel
transcript.text: Don't bother, I'm out of here! Good luck on your own, Elizabeth! Have a nice life!

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth
transcript.text: ARGH! That...you...that no good, cheating...Oh, he'll get what's coming to him, yes he will! ...ZAX, where's Matt?

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Candidate Matthew Johnston is currently...

transcript.speaker: Elizabeth
transcript.text: You know what, forget it. I'll find him myself.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Goodbye.

items.name: Overseer's Terminal
items.lead: A terminal you can read in the world.

entries.title: Welcome, Overseer!
entries.text:
Congratulations, Overseer [INSERT CANDIDATE NAME]! 

You have proven yourself victorious over your fellow candidates and achieved the rank of Overseer! Thank you for participating. Your service to your country and to Vault-Tec will not go unnoticed. Rest assured, your praises will be sung by all you meet!    

Now that the selection process has concluded, you are free to sit back and enjoy the benefits the position of Overseer affords you. As Overseer of this vault, you have only one duty: It's up to you to oversee the selection of the next Overseer! The selection process will begin immediately. Access to the Overseer's room will be terminated for Overseer [INSERT CANDIDATE NAME]. 

We hope you enjoyed the luxuries your brief stint as Overseer afforded you. Thank you for participating in the Vault 51 Overseer selection process. Good luck in the upcoming selection process!

entries.title: INTERCEPTED COMMUNICATION

items.name: Reuben Gill - 20840520
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Recording. Overseer Reuben Gill. May 20, 2084.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Overseer Gill, welcome to the Security Room. Who do you have business with today?

transcript.speaker: Reuben
transcript.text: Go away, ZAX. I don't have business with anyone, or did you forget?

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: You have many events on your agenda today, Overseer Gill. Your position is very important, Overseer Gill!

transcript.speaker: Reuben
transcript.text: Stop calling me that! What "events?" What could I possibly have to do here? I'm the only one left!

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: The Overseer has many duties! Also, the Overseer's rations are ready for deployment.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Unfortunately, as I have noted, you have not earned this meal so it will, ultimately, disappoint you.

transcript.speaker: Reuben
transcript.text: I don't care about that! Just drop them at my door and leave me alone!

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Understood. However, records show that Reuben Gill has no business in the security room, so I must demand that you leave.

transcript.speaker: Reuben
transcript.text: ZAX, I'm the Overseer. I can be wherever I want, you never said I couldn't be here, anyway.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Certainly, you are the Overseer; however, access to the security room has now been disabled for Overseer Candidates with Rank 1 Overseer Access.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Thank you for understanding!

transcript.speaker: Reuben
transcript.text: Overseer Rank?! You're making that up. Wait, what the hell? I was looking at that!

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Sorry, Overseer! You will need higher Overseer Rank to access that Terminal! Have a nice day!

items.name: Reuben Gill - 20940303
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Recording. Overseer Reuben Gill. March 03, 2094.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Overseer Gill, good evening.

transcript.speaker: Reuben
transcript.text: ZAX, I told you not to bother me any more today, what is so important that you have to bother me again?

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Overseer Gill, your behavior has been quite erratic lately. Is something bothering you?

transcript.speaker: Reuben
transcript.text: The only thing bothering me is how often you've been spying on me! As Overseer, I demand you stop "observing" me at once!

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Processing request. Monitoring has ceased within areas the Overseer has sufficient Overseer Access.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: However, as the Overseer is currently located in an area he is prohibited, I must request that the Overseer vacate immediately.

transcript.speaker: Reuben
transcript.text: You can't do that! How can you keep me out of the Overseer office?! I AM the Overseer!

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: I can do that, Overseer Gill.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Equipment in this area is failing at a rate 89.7% higher than the expected rate and must begin maintenance immediately. Thank you for understanding.

transcript.speaker: Reuben
transcript.text: You can't keep me out of here, this is the Overseer's office! My office! I have every right to be here!

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Apologies, Overseer, but ZAX is currently focused on maintenance and cannot comply at this time. Thank you for understanding.

transcript.speaker: Reuben
transcript.text: Hey, stop! Turn that monitor back on! You can't do this to me, ZAX!

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Thank you for understanding.

items.name: Reuben Gill - 21021023
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Recording. Overseer Reuben Gill. October 23, 2102.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Greetings, Overseer Gill. The date is now October 23rd, 2102. Happy Reclamation Day.

transcript.speaker: Reuben
transcript.text: Why in god's name are you bothering me this early in the morning? And what the hell is "Reclamation Day?"

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Analyzing air particles... results: there is a 96.1% chance the Overseer is inebriated.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Again.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Reclamation Day is the day Vault 76 opens, marking the dawn of a new America.

transcript.speaker: Reuben
transcript.text: There's another Vault opening? Where?! I want to go there! ZAX, open the doors! As Overseer, I command you!

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Request denied. The location of Vault 76 is prohibited for all dwellers in this Vault except the Overseer.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Also, ZAX has relieved you from the Overseer position and must begin the process of selecting a new Overseer.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Apologies, former Overseer.

transcript.speaker: Reuben
transcript.text: Your "selection process?!" Why would you do that again, to more people, after what happened last time?

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Reuben Gill, while I was impressed with your ability to outwit your fellow candidates, unfortunately, you were a very poor Overseer.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: ZAX will analyze your performance and use this data to select a more suitable Overseer.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Also, by agreeing to live in this Vault, you are required to participate in the next Overseer selection process.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Have a nice day, candidate Gill.

transcript.speaker: Reuben
transcript.text: Wait, ZAX?! ZAX!!!

transcript.speaker: Reuben
transcript.text: ...Not again... I can't...

transcript.speaker: Reuben
transcript.text: I have to get out of here.

items.name: Reuben Gill to Whoever Finds This Vault
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Reuben
transcript.text: My name is Reuben Gill. I was one of the 50 people living in Vault 51 and... am the only one of us alive.

transcript.speaker: Reuben
transcript.text: I was the... "Overseer" of this Vault and the things I did to get that position I don't want to remember...

transcript.speaker: Reuben
transcript.text: But I can't ever... WON'T ever forget.

transcript.speaker: Reuben
transcript.text: This Vault was home to many wonderful people. Caring, loving people... and that computer took them all away.

transcript.speaker: Reuben
transcript.text: It turned us against each other for "research." Ended their lives for a sadistic experiment.

transcript.speaker: Reuben
transcript.text: ZAX... he'll make promises, offer you luxuries, make you feel safe... all a farce. Part of his ruse.

transcript.speaker: Reuben
transcript.text: I don't know what he's planned for you but it'll end the same way. ZAX will get what he wants and bleed you dry in the process.

transcript.speaker: Reuben
transcript.text: I need to get as far away from here as possible before ZAX starts... researching. I can't be a part of that again.

transcript.speaker: Reuben
transcript.text: To whoever finds this... good luck. Maybe you'll have it better than we did... but I doubt it.

transcript.speaker: Reuben
transcript.text: You never shoulda come here.

items.name: Sgt. Baker - 20771013
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Recording. Sergeant Robert Baker. October 13, 2077.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Good morning, Sergeant Robert Baker. I am ZAX.

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Baker
transcript.text: Hello, ZAX. Please, call me Bob. Is my family okay?

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Please hold. According to records from Vault REDACTED, Joshua Baker, Anna Baker, and Christina Baker are present.

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Baker
transcript.text: Can't tell me, huh... don't matter, that's a load off my back. So, where do we go from here? I've gotta teach you about... leadership?

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Baker
transcript.text: How'm I supposed to teach that to a computer...

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Affirmative. You are to assist this ZAX unit in the selection of an Overseer for Vault 51.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: ZAX will determine the best candidate through its own internal thought process, which will be formed as ZAX interacts with those living in the Vault.

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Baker
transcript.text: I see. And, right now, what is "determined" to be the "best candidate?"

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Undetermined. At present, Sergeant Bob would be the finest Overseer.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: However, ZAX is prohibited from awarding Sergeant Bob the position of Overseer unless there are no other candidates remaining.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Thank you for understanding.

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Baker
transcript.text: Makes sense, no reason to teach you if I just up and take over. Well, for starters, once all them folks get in here, how about a vote?

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Baker
transcript.text: That's how we always done things in America and it's the greatest country on earth.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Researching. After analysis, a "vote" would be a satisfactory choice for the first experiment.

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Baker
transcript.text: ... the "first" experiment?

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Affirmative. ZAX must perform many experiments to determine the qualities suitable for an Overseer.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Determining the position of Overseer through the actions of the people inside the Vault is insignificant;

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: ZAX must be able to determine the Overseer through its own processes.

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Baker
transcript.text: I... see. Well, as long as you and your Vault-Tec buddies keep my family safe, I'll help you as much as I can, ZAX. Pleasure to be workin' with ya.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Thank you, Sergeant Bob.

items.name: Sgt. Baker - 20771120
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Recording. Subject Sergeant Robert Baker. November 20, 2077.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Sergeant Bob, these results are insufficient. Exactly what qualities define a "leader?"

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Baker
transcript.text: Good morning to you, too, ZAX. That's a pretty loaded question this early in the morning.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: According to research, leaders are "voted," however, after many attempts, no one has been chosen "leader."

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Every subject votes for themselves or a handful of others. No one has even become "majority," let alone unanimous.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: That is unacceptable. ZAX has determined that voting is pointless and another method will be used to select a leader.

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Baker
transcript.text: Whoa, slow down there, partner. That's pretty hasty, throwing away the foundation of Democracy after a month.

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Baker
transcript.text: But, you're supposed to learn, so I'll help ya nonetheless.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Thank you. How were you chosen as leader? According to records, you were never a "voted" official.

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Baker
transcript.text: Well, I earned my rank from fightin' in that war. But my men... well, someone had to step up.

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Baker
transcript.text: To me, a real leader is someone who steps up in a crisis and takes control of a situation, whether they were chosen or not.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Interesting. I do not fully understand. I must process this information. Thank you, Sergeant Bob.

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Baker
transcript.text: Any time, ZAX. Good luck to you.

items.name: Sgt. Baker - 20780727
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Recording. Sergeant Robert Baker. July 27, 2078.

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Baker
transcript.text: ZAX! Hey, ZAX, where are you? ZAX!

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Good morning, Sergeant Bob. You sound agitated. Is there something I can help you with?

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Baker
transcript.text: You mind telling me what this is?

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Analyzing. That is a 10 millimeter autoloading pistol.

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Baker
transcript.text: I know that but what in god's name is it doing here in this Vault? Some fool damn near shot up the cafeteria before I had to take him down.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Yes, that was very dangerous for you. The speed at which you disarmed him was quite impressive.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: As was how quickly you used his weapon to execute him. I am glad you survived that encounter.

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Baker
transcript.text: I shouldn't have been in that "encounter" at all! How did he get this piece? I thought firearms were banned from this place, did he smuggle it in?

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Negative, all firearms were removed from the candidates' possessions.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: I concluded that current conditions in the Vault did not fit the criteria of forcing a crisis.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Without external threats, crisis can only come from within the Vault.

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Baker
transcript.text: Are you saying you're trying to get these people to kill each other? That is wrong, ZAX.

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Baker
transcript.text: Arming these untrained, unstable individuals is not gonna produce a leader, just a pile of corpses. This ain't gonna end the way you think it is.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: ZAX believes this will hasten the process of selecting an Overseer. Since the Vault closed, three individuals have died in the Vault.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: According to calculations, lessening the number of candidates facilitates the Overseer selection process.

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Baker
transcript.text: You can't just treat people like they're numbers, ZAX!

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Baker
transcript.text: I don't think I can be a part of this any longer, if what you're taking from me is that you've gotta get these people killed.

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Baker
transcript.text: I can't help you do that, ZAX.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Refusal denied; logic does not compute. ZAX is not permitted to terminate humans.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: ZAX's primary directive is to select an Overseer.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: It is not necessary for Sergeant Bob to kill any individuals in the Vault, he did so on his own volition.

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Baker
transcript.text: I can't talk to you right now, ZAX. Leave me alone.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Affirmative. Good night, Sergeant Bob.

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Baker
transcript.text: This is insane... what in the hell did they sign me up for...

items.name: Sgt. Baker - 20780806
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Recording. Sergeant Robert Baker. August 6, 2078.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Sergeant Bob, according to records, you have recently been shot.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: I request you remove the barricade placed in your room so medical help can be administered.

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Baker
transcript.text: I... I don't think so ZAX. This is it for me. I'm done here.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Incorrect. Sergeant Bob's job is to instruct ZAX. He is not permitted to refuse medical help.

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Baker
transcript.text: Well, it doesn't sound like you can do anything about it. You shouldn'ta... shouldn't have given those people guns, ZAX.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: I do not understand. Analysis shows that if Sergeant Bob incapacitated candidate Reuben Gill he would have prevented the fatalities of 3 candidates.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: But, instead, you did not act. Why?

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Baker
transcript.text: Because, ZAX, I'm done killing. I kill him, then what? Someone else gets his gun and kills people. Kill him, someone else kills more.

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Baker
transcript.text: And I'm done with that life. This cycle won't end. Giving those poor fools guns was a bad idea, ZAX.

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Baker
transcript.text: Ain't... Ain't gonna be anyone for your "Overseer" to "oversee."

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Analysis shows that 78% of recorded fatalities in the Vault would have happened over a longer period.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Providing firearms attained the expected results in a vastly accelerated time frame.

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Baker
transcript.text: I should have realized you were never gonna understand. Answer me this, at least, ZAX? Is... is my family... okay?

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Joshua Baker, Anna Baker, and Christina Baker were killed in an accident before their Vault closed.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: However, their Vault did close properly, preserving the lives of the other dwellers of the Vault.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Sergeant Bob, your heartbeat has terminated and there is a 99.7% chance you have died. You will be transported from your quarters to the medical bay.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Analysis: provided weaponry was effective in producing results but in a longer timeframe than expected.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: According to Sergeant Bob's instructions, military firearms training should not be expected from candidates.

transcript.speaker: ZAX
transcript.text: Results: Candidates should be provided better weaponry.

items.name: Terminal — Vault 51
items.lead: A terminal you can read in the world.

entries.title: Regarding Nancy's Death
entries.text:
To all Vault 51 residents,

Hello, everyone. I know tensions have been running high, but now, more than ever, we need to agree to put our hostilities aside and work together.

After a thorough investigation, I have come to the conclusion that my initial thoughts were both naïve and incorrect; what happened to Nancy was no accident, it was murder.

I don't know who would have done such a thing but it's become clear that Nancy died from strangulation and not the fall from the upper deck. I would like everyone to tell me what they know so we can bring her killer to justice.

I asked ZAX what he had recorded but he had no information, which means we have to solve this mystery on our own. I trust you all and consider you as family and only by cooperation can we survive both now and in the new world to come.

Thank you all.

Helen Marks, 06/15/2078

items.name: Terminal — Vault 51
items.lead: A terminal you can read in the world.

entries.title: Eleanor Montgomery, 05/20/2078
entries.text:
It happened again! I've been a high-stakes gambler since I was 14 and now I can't beat a bunch of amateurs stuck in this box?! How can I have such bad luck?!

I haven't eaten in almost a week now. That stupid machine and these stupid games... I know a rigged game when I see one, ZAX! I deserve to win more than BILL.

I saw Bill get up after winning for hours, I sit down and can't win a cent! And wherever Bill plays he just wins more and more! That's my food, not yours, Bill!

I'll beat you, Bill. One way or another... I'm going to win.

items.name: Terminal — Vault 51
items.lead: A terminal you can read in the world.

entries.title: Brianna Ware, 05/01/2078
entries.text:
I don't understand how ZAX can let this happen. Isaiah is a pro boxer!

We're all hungry but Isaiah didn't need to do that to poor Freddy... And who could even stop him? At least it was only Freddy that got hurt.

We don't know what to do about any of this... do we punish Isaiah? ZAX didn't even try and stop it, he even praised Isaiah's "initiative," whatever that means. At least it looks like ZAX is monitoring Freddy's health, or we think he is. No one's seen Freddy for a few days.

How could it come to this? We need a better way to protect ourselves to keep people like Isaiah from taking control by force.

items.name: Terminal — Vault 51
items.lead: A terminal you can read in the world.

entries.title: Rachael Shields, 06/03/2078
entries.text:
We've been here for three months and none of this makes sense. I thought this was a place to go for protection, but it's so, so much more.

This AI that runs the place, ZAX... it won't answer any questions about the Vault, about the outside world. It only wants us to "become Overseer," and keeps repeating that.

That's not all, though. In just a few months, the Vault feels... alive.

We don't know if it's ZAX or someone else, but we'll take something from the kitchen and it's back the next day. Put something where it isn't supposed to be and it's gone when we turn our heads. And none of us knows how!

And yesterday Terrence found a gun! I get it... who knows what might happen in the future... but why wasn't it locked up? Is there some threat we didn't know about? ZAX has kept its mouth shut, saying that we're lucky to survive... but survive what? Is everything out there... gone?

It doesn't matter, I'm going to keep digging - there's got to be more to this story!

items.name: Terminal — Vault 51
items.lead: A terminal you can read in the world.

entries.title: Aiden Higgins, 02/21/2078
entries.text:
I'm writing this to you, ZAX - I know you're reading these! I know you're conspiring against me. I'm the winningest lawyer in the state, valedictorian... have you seen my car? Since I don't want to "play nice" with the other nobodies in this place you want to punish me for it? Not gonna happen, pal!

I can take one on the chin... amateur boxing champion, you know! But shoving me in these bunks, making me live in this closet with nothing but the clothes on my back?! Not in my lifetime, buddy! If you're gonna try and stack the deck against me then go ahead... if you're ready for the consequences.

I know you care about your precious Vault and you won't tell us what's going on outside. Maybe I'll just have to find out for myself? Just try and stop me, ZAX!

items.name: Terminal — Vault 51
items.lead: A terminal you can read in the world.

entries.title: Stephen Burnett, 02/27/2078
entries.text:
This Vault is so confusing to me. Ever since we got here crazy stuff keeps happening, but what happened this week... wow. We thought we might be done for after that moron Aiden blew up the lounge area and himself in the process; we thought he did enough damage to bust a hole in the Vault. Boy, were we wrong.

That area was blocked off for less than a week and we woke up today to see the area opened up again and a full garden in its place! Went and looked upstairs and saw the old lounge was replaced with this beautiful, upscale living area... it's mind-blowing.

How do things pop out of thin air with no one noticing? Everything about this Vault confuses me. Can't wait for word from outside, I'd like to get back to work.

entries.title: Angela Callahan, 06/05/2078
entries.text:
To ZAX, our savior and leader, glory above all.

It has been many months since our ascension to the holy land of ZAX and every day we give many thanks for his blessings. Another day has taken more of the non-believers, thanks be to ZAX.

Every day we are honored to be his champion. Every day we work in his honor. Every day we struggle to show philistines the light. Glory to ZAX.

Should we see the morrow, we shall give thanks to ZAX for his blessings, as he allows us to live and worship. Should we die, we shall live eternally with him. Praise to ZAX.

All hail ZAX.

entries.title: Rosemary Villa, 03/05/2078
entries.text:
A talent show sounded like a fun idea, especially after we lost Aiden... Everyone was so excited for some R&R, and then ZAX changed the rules... if we knew we had to risk our room there's no way we would have participated! 

We're amateurs with no practice or training, how could we compare to CARMEN GREENE?! She's a world class singer! And Stephanie played with the Huntington Philharmonic! It was so unfair! 

And now they move upstairs and we're all sharing this tiny room! Crystal and Helen are absolutely furious with me. Maybe Helen can convince Reuben to trade rooms with us. That guy will do anything for Helen.

items.name: Terminal — Vault 51
items.lead: A terminal you can read in the world.

entries.title: These Campaigns Must Stop
entries.text:
Chris, Joel, Francis and Vanessa: this has to stop. These votes aren't getting us anywhere.

I know ZAX wants us to choose an Overseer, but after three votes in a row, we haven't gotten anywhere! We have no Overseer and everyone is starting to take this very seriously. I had to break up a fight between your supporters yesterday and someone took a swing at me! I don't think anyone even cares who the Overseer is, only that their side wins.

You four are the only ones that seem care about the position so I implore you to come to a consensus and pick someone yourself before the situation escalates.

Edwin Reed, 01/23/2078

items.name: Terminal — Vault 51
items.lead: A terminal you can read in the world.

entries.title: I Need Your Help
entries.text:
Bob... I need your help. It's Helen... she's dead. And before you ask: it wasn't me! I had my problems with her and that weasel Reuben but I wouldn't do anything like this!

I found her lying in the mess hall, face first on the table. There was no blood, nothing... did someone poison her? Where did someone find poison in the Vault?!

Everyone's on edge right now and you're the only person that might listen to me. We must keep this from Reuben, the way he was always following Helen around. Please, Bob, you're the only one that can help me.

Omar Stephens, 08/06/2078

entries.title: ZAX Console Log: 10/23/2080
Re: Hellfire Prototype Requisition Request
entries.text:
Dr. Braun, your request has been accepted. A Hellfire Prototype power armor unit will be shipped to Vault 51 immediately. The Enclave research team apologizes for the delay.

Original Message:
To the fools at Vault-Tec,
Your refusal to comply with my requests are preposterous. My subordinates have requested many times for a set of Hellfire Prototype power armor and every time they are ignored! Now, I must leave from my simulations to contact you myself! Ridiculous!
I don't even need to explain myself. Send a set of this armor to Vault 51 immediately, it is of the utmost importance. And do not make me ask again!
Dr. Stanislaus Braun

entries.title: Overseer Selection Attempt 2
entries.text:
TEST #2: Date: 11/28/77

Candidates were directed to form groups and select a representative, and then all dwellers were directed to choose an Overseer from the available candidates. 

RESULTS: Failure. Resulted in same conclusion as the previous vote. 

//DATA CORRUPTED... Repairing.

entries.title: Overseer Selection Attempt 17
entries.text:
TEST #17: Date: 03/21/78

As suggested by candidate Wilson, candidates were provided casino games and competed against each other, with the winner determined by overall earnings. 

RESULTS: Failure. Before a winner could be determined, candidates began to fight and the competition was not concluded. 

//DATA CORRUPTED... Repairing.

entries.title: Overseer Selection Attempt 37
entries.text:
TEST #37: Date: 08/06/78 

Candidates have been pitted against each other in order to find the final survivor. This would be, by definition, the most suitable Overseer. 

RESULTS: Pending. While an Overseer was eventually selected, he was not a suitable choice as he has not performed his primary directive.

Future tests will be conducted without approval of the previous Overseer.

entries.title: Emotional Response Experiment 13
entries.text:
Test #13: Date: 06/01/78

Candidate response to lifeform [HOUSEFLY] observed. 

TESTING PROTOCOL: Insect lifeform [HOUSEFLY] introduced to Vault 51 living quarters.  

RESULTS: Success. Prolonged exposure to [HOUSEFLY] caused extreme irritability and instability among candidates. Failure to exterminate [HOUSEFLY] after 72 hours sufficient to cause violent reactions among some candidates. Three fatalities.  

NOTES: [HOUSEFLY] sound frequencies have been duplicated for future broadcast as a means of inciting instability and violence.

entries.title: Emotional Response Experiment 17
entries.text:
Test #17: Date: 07/13/78 

Candidate response to game imbalance measured. 

TESTING PROTOCOL: Game programs on candidates' terminals were altered to artificially boost some candidates' chances of winning and reduce other candidates' chances. 

RESULTS : Success. Game imbalance caused irritability and anxiety among candidates whose chances of winning were decreased. Candidates whose chances of winning were increased reported feelings of superiority.  

NOTES: Hostility among these opposing groups will be monitored. Necessary adjustments required to incite violence.

entries.title: Emotional Response Experiment 23
entries.text:
Test #23: Date: 08/02/78    

Candidate response to altered sleep schedule measured. 

TESTING PROTOCOL: Vault 51 scheduling programs altered. Wake-up alarms sounded at 05:30 am for seven days to measure candidate response. 

RESULTS: Failure. Altered sleep schedule caused increased irritability in many candidates, but movement impetus and cognitive ability were significantly decreased. Use of expletives and consumption of caffeine noticeably increased.  

NOTES: Dining hall coffee will be switched for [DECAFFEINATED COFFEE] to monitor candidate response.

entries.title: Appalachia Report - 1/18/03
entries.text:
Environment Report: Radiation levels have decreased significantly, allowing limited fauna regrowth. Climate volatility has increased, likely due to lingering effects from The Great War. At current pace, region may see an influence of pyroclastic storms.

Logistics Report: Limited access to area Vertibots gained. Transfer of resources across the towns of Flatwoods, Sutton and Helvetia have begun, as well as other areas in the region. Reports that attacks from local fauna have caused supplies to be lost around the area. Plans to reclaim errant supplies are on hold.

Fauna Report: Extermination of local fauna has begun. Attempts to fully eradicate creatures have ended in failure. Capture and containment in progress. Tests to determine effectiveness in Overseer selection process in progress.

Human Report: Population in area has increased. Many subjects have demonstrated extreme hostility towards local fauna and other humans. Subjects show high potential for Overseer selection process. Recruitment plans are in progress.

entries.title: SPECIAL REPORT: Anomalous Lifeforms Detected
entries.text:
//BEGINNING ROUTINE TEST

//SCANNING: Performing routine scan of area surrounding Vault 51

.........Success; biological life forms identified.

Analysis of movement patterns indicates humans may remain among surviving biological life forms.

Commencing analysis.

//ANALYZING: Identifying potential humans in Appalachia

Data indicates that nuclear activity in the Appalachian region did not result in annihilation of humans.

Suitable Overseer candidates may exist among survivors. 

Commencing analysis.

//ANALYZING: Analyzing behavior patterns among human survivors

.......... Success; analysis complete.

Human survivors clustered in groups near manmade structures.

Rudimentary townships observed.

Surviving groups appear peaceful.

Suitable Overseer candidates not identified among surviving humans.

................................................... 

ERROR; anomalous life form identified.

Commencing analysis.

//SCANNING: Identifying anomalous life form

.......... Success; biological life form identified.

CONCLUSION: Anomalous life form identified as [HUMAN]. Further observation required.

//ANALYZING: Analyzing behavior patterns among human anomalous human life forms

.......... Success; analysis complete.

Anomalous life form is a mutated human. Mutation causes human life form to appear burned.

Burned humans exhibit violence towards non-burned humans and other biological life forms.

Suitable Overseer candidates may exist among burned humans.

Commencing analysis.

//ANALYZING: Identifying suitable Overseer candidates among burned humans

.......... Failure; successful Overseer candidates not identified.

Burned humans appear to work in tandem. Hive-mind behavior observed. Preliminary observation suggests burned humans are hostile to all life forms excepting other burned humans.

Unwillingness to sabotage members of their own social groups disqualifies burned humans as Overseer candidates.

Further testing needed to determine whether non-burned humans exhibit similar unwillingness to enact violence against members of their social groups.

//ROUTINE TEST COMPLETE

items.name: Good Luck
items.lead: A note lying in the world.
items.contents:
Orders say we can't arm the Ressies, but I say the hell with that.

Nobody knows what you're going to face out there, so I'll be damned if I let you do it with nothing but a winning smile and a good attitude. I've snuck a pistol in with the rest of your supplies. Not like the weapons are doing any good sitting in storage here, anyway.

Good luck. We're all going to need it.

entries.title: Vault-Tec Report
entries.text:
CONFIDENTIAL CONFIDENTIAL CONFIDENTIAL 
OVERSEER EYES ONLY | VIOLATION VTP-01076

Twenty-five (25) years after the Vault Doors close, you are to prepare your citizens to leave Vault 76 and begin a process called "Reclamation." Specifics will be disseminated automatically as that time approaches.

After Reclamation Day, you are personally ordered to find and secure three nuclear silos code-named ALPHA, BRAVO, and CHARLIE. If these sites are still nuclear capable ensure no one except Vault-Tec can access or launch nuclear ordnance.

To be clear, even if there are other authorities (whether government, militia, or otherwise) their claims are to be ignored. Vault-Tec alone maintains jurisdiction.

entries.title: Vault 76 Parameters
entries.text:
CONFIDENTIAL CONFIDENTIAL CONFIDENTIAL 
OVERSEER EYES ONLY | VIOLATION VTP-01076

Congratulations, Overseer.

Vault 76 is one of the most important projects that Vault-Tec has completed. No expense has been spared on building, staffing, and selecting the inhabitants of your Vault. The cream of the crop of America have been chosen, including luminaries from Vault-Tec University.

The special classes and instruction you've received about managing a Vault do not apply to this assignment. Vault 76 is special. Your mission is to see to the livelihood and well-being of all your residents and make sure they're ready to colonize America once the All-Clear is received.

It is to be expected you will face challenges we haven't prepared you for. Adapt, learn, and thrive. America is counting on you.

entries.title: Day to Day Duties
entries.text:
Your job as the Overseer is to see to the overall health and safety of Vault 76. Avoid loss of life at all costs. The Vault Residents have been carefully chosen for their unique skills and temperament.

Due to the aptitude of the Vault Residents, you may be presented with unique challenges in maintaining order. As a last resort, each domicile can be locked down and the resident imprisoned for any duration you deem appropriate. Enforced solitary confinement can lead to psychological issues, so factor that in.

Although the Vault Doors cannot be opened from the inside, keep the entry clear of all unauthorized personnel. The Security Team will stow all weapons and munitions after the amended entry period and will be armed solely with non-lethal devices.

If America is to be rebuilt, every life in this Vault is special. Preserve them all.

entries.title: Mandatory Shut Down
entries.text:
Our studies have shown even after a relatively short duration of living with the amenities of Vault-Tec that test subjects can grow to depend on them. That will not do for Vault 76.

After the All-Clear Message is received, Vault 76 will shutdown all functions inside of 24 hours. Air circulation will cease last, and you should warn the Vault Residents that staying inside the Vault can be lethal after this period.

Everyone must leave the nest. It's imperative that all residents are focused on the important job of rebuilding America.

entries.title: Reclamation Day Has Arrived
entries.text:
We counted down to Midnight. I haven't seen everyone cheer like that since Vault baby number one was born.

I called lights out a couple hours ago. Had to get security to help a few people to their beds. Then the volunteers and I got all the standees set up, just like we practiced.

Need to make the final recordings, and then... it'll be time to head out that door. I wish I could be there to help everyone on their way, but I know they'll make me proud.

entries.title: Survival First
entries.text:
As instructed we set up the survival packages. I've advised everyone to run fast and far from 76 as soon as the doors open. 

We have no information about what awaits us. Vault-Tec says we're America's best hope. Now we'll find out.

entries.title: Annual Review: 2100
entries.text:
Another year down. Our mission continues.

==TOP ISSUES==

*At current count, 6 residents are under Disciplinary Lockdown. That's up from 4 last year. The Morale Officer has managed to quash the worst rumors about Appalachia - cannibal mutants, burning rain, whatever - but tensions are high.

*It's generally pretty easy to maintain order. The pedigree of most of the residents is... impressive, to say the least. But competence sometimes means arrogance. And arrogance means my authority gets tested - more often than it should.

*Hydroponics has been struggling to keep up with demand. I've been loath to institute mandatory rationing, but in 2101 that may be necessary. 76 is full to bursting with people, more than we anticipated.

==TOP SUCCESSES==

*The award ceremonies are a great way of stroking the most hardened egos, since everyone's so damned competitive. The low point was someone losing a tooth in a fight over the "Best Dental Hygiene" award...

*The senior staff has been exemplary, as always. Very dependable and loyal. It's been a struggle to keep our over-achievers placated, but another year down and we're still here.

*The Vault 76 World Cup has proven to be a huge hit. The ball damn near broke the jukebox, but the energy in the atrium was just amazing.

entries.text: If ANYONE is found accessing this terminal and is not a member of the Personnel Department, you will be immediately reported to the Security Chief. No exceptions.

entries.title: Missing Nuka-Cola Cherry
entries.text:
From:      Daily, J
Subject:   Missing Nuka-Cola Cherry

Just because we're leaving, doesn't give any of you the right to steal from my stash of Nuka-Cola Cherry. I have been rationing those bottles for over 20 years. If I catch any of you, so help me God, there will be consequences.

entries.title: About my reassignment
entries.text:
From:      Sullivan, T
Subject:   About my reassignment

I realize that it may seem trivial in light of present circumstances, but I would greatly appreciate my reassignment being processed before Reclamation Day. I have worked many years to pass all written, verbal, and physical tests to become a Sanitation Engineer. 

I have a Doctorate of Engineering from GSU and I don't want to end my tenure at our Vault 76 as a Soda Jerk. Please, let me have the accolades I have earned.

Thanks in advance.

entries.title: Purge all records
entries.text:
From:      Security Chief
Subject:   Purge all records

Vault-Tec's Reclamation Procedure is very clear. All records must be purged before R-Day.

To be clear, after Reclamation Day there will be no personnel department. There will be no Vault 76. Any of the projects you're in the middle of are done.

If you, for some reason, can't find the time to erase your files I'll send someone over to do it for you. You can bring it up to the Overseer if you like.

entries.title: VAULT 76 SECURITY INSTRUCTIONS
entries.text:
CONFIDENTIAL CONFIDENTIAL CONFIDENTIAL
SECURITY EYES ONLY | VIOLATION VTP-01076

Vault 76 is one of the most highly valuable and important Vaults in our network. As such, these orders must be obeyed at all costs. The future of America is at stake.

Upon receiving the Activation Notice your team is authorized to use lethal force. Any obstacle or threat that stands between you and getting Vault Residents safely inside the Vault must be dealt with decisively. Only authorized residents are allowed inside, all other personnel should be considered enemy combatants.

The Overseer has special instruction after the Activation Notice. As soon as the entry procedures are complete, your team must stow all weapons in the specified containers. Further orders will then be dispensed.

Trust your Overseer. Obey your Overseer. Know that each and every member of your team was selected specifically for this assignment because of Vault-Tec's faith in you. If you work together, you will succeed.

entries.title: Drunk and Disorderly
entries.text:
Jill caught M Thompson singing loudly during the night cycle. He got into the Reclamation party stores and "borrowed" a 6 pack. 

The rules say the theft mandates Lock Down. But what's the point? In 2 days everyone's out anyhow.

Threw Thompson in the holding cell to sleep it off.

entries.title: Assault Investigated
entries.text:
Nakamura investigated a complaint filed by our old friend Jake. Jake claimed that E Jefferson shoved him with intent to commit bodily injury.

Nakamura found a witness and Jake was gently shoved out of the way after he was laying into Jefferson about being an ineffectual ass. 

Asked the chief whether we could nail Jake for filing a false report. Chief said that Jake technically was assaulted, though. So it's dropped.

God, I hate lawyers.

entries.title: Unauthorized Access Investigation
entries.text:
Terminal 023-B was hacked last night. Sandy investigated and we've got no idea who did it. The Reclamation files were accessed, however, which has the chief furious.

What does he expect? Half the Ressies are god damned geniuses, how are we supposed to keep them out of restricted files?

Doubled up the shifts so we have more eyes out there. Like that'll help.

entries.title: Theft Investigated
entries.text:
Another claim from Jake. Again. Sent Nakamura over, she's the only one that doesn't want to strangle the guy.

Jake claims he's missing one box of Sugar Bombs from his room. He's demanding we investigate it. One box of Sugar Bombs? Told Nakamura to drop the investigation. With Reclamation coming we have far more important things to do.

entries.title: Final entry
entries.text:
25 years of service, no KIAs, and one hell of a send off. I made one last plea to arm the Ressies before we open, denied.

My solemn hope is generations from now visitors will come to 76 and read this and know how dedicated their forefathers were. How we regrew America from the ashes.

But, I must admit I'm afraid, as well. If some of the experiments in the other Vaults go wrong... It can give you nightmares. And that's only the things I know about.

If we can only stick together, work together, I think we stand a chance.

entries.title: Keeping a lid on it
entries.text:
Had to lock down Casey for blabbing about the Activation Notice. The cat's already out of the bag, but orders are orders.

Procedure is we announce tomorrow, but you can feel the excitement. The team keeps asking what to expect out there. The nukes knocked out our external sensors so we're blind. Only the secondary geiger counters are operational.

Scuttlebutt gone wild. Lots of whispering of who's grouping up with who after Reclamation. I worry that the biggest threat to the Project isn't any threat we'll face out there, it's from within. The Ressies are a formidable lot, but give them free reign and Lord help us.

entries.title: Rundown Complete
entries.text:
Team tore through the Activation Notice checklist. Logs wiped, non-essential gear secured, Reclamation Packages acquired, etc. The whole procedure went down in record time, like we've been practicing for years.

Some grumbling about unleashing the Ressies without the Overseer keeping them in check. But overall, a good performance.

entries.title: VAULT 76
entries.text: VAULT 76: Commemorating our country's Tricentennial, this control Vault was built and designed to open at a future date. Its occupants will be instructed and tasked with the role of rebuilding our civilization, in case of total annihilation.

items.name: Dean Harland Elliot's Workstation
items.lead: A terminal you can read in the world.

entries.title: Hornwright, Liam
entries.text:
My understanding is that Mr Hornwright is attending school primarily to "party" and spends the majority of his time in a haze of marijuana, hence his absurd and hastily banged out proposal.  However, his family connections make him a potential liability so we will have to see how we handle his future training.

- H. Elliot

entries.title: Collingsworth, Drew
entries.text:
Collingsworth's proposed experiment has evolved beyond my wildest expectations.  His initial proposal mirrored other successful food replacement schemes, and even showed a little imagination for once.  I pushed him towards a more interesting experiment that should test the general willpower of individuals and how they react to deaths caused by food supply. I've tasted his pastes, they're suitably horrible, so we're going to mass produce them and add an arterial plaquing agent that should cause rapid circulatory system decline.  I expect a full blown revolt within two weeks and we should be able to end the experiment in the middle of week 3.

- H. Elliot

entries.title: O'Rourke, Shelby
entries.text:
O'Rourke has proven to be persistent enough to convince me to grant her a small amount of funding for her thesis project to provide evidence of so-called cryptids. Should she prove the existence and have appropriate data, this would be a major breakthrough that Vault-Tec can surely benefit from. If anything, it gets her out of my hair for a few months. 

Should she not return within her given time period, we'll need to find a team to locate wherever she holed up and retrieve any data for investigation.

- H. Elliot

items.name: First Day of School
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Scott Warner
transcript.text: This is even better than I expected! Growing up in Welch, I never would have expected to get this opportunity! My dad said not to let the big city get to my head, but I can barely stand it I'm so excited!

transcript.speaker: Scott Warner
transcript.text: This list of courses is thrilling, and I'll be learning from some of the best. Dean Elliot is a legend, and Professor Blake literally wrote the book on psychology in confined situations.

transcript.speaker: Scott Warner
transcript.text: I know it's early, but I've been working on my Senior Thesis since I was in grade school, and I've got an appointment with Dean Elliot to go over it with him. I know it's a silly little idea, but I think it can be something real special with his help.

transcript.speaker: Scott Warner
transcript.text: Selective breeding is the toughest but to crack, but I think that the confines of a vault are a fantastic place to put these ideas to the test in a controlled environment. I've studied the history and I have an angle that no one has thought of.

transcript.speaker: Trisha Miller
transcript.text: Turned down by a potential boss once again. If you'd told me when I first got here that I would be anything other than the Overseer of a control vault, I wouldn't have believed you.

transcript.speaker: Trisha Miller
transcript.text: Now that I'm here I'm a little more realistic about things. The Overseer at Vault 96, one of the hottest postings outside of 76, wouldn't even give me the time of day.

transcript.speaker: Trisha Miller
transcript.text: The man sent me a form letter as a rejection for god's sake. At this rate, I'm going to end up shipped out to the west coast to work as a janitor in 29 with a bunch of obnoxious rich teenagers or something.

transcript.speaker: Trisha Miller
transcript.text: It's pretty clear to me now that Vault Tec is a hive of nepotism and ass-kissing. You can't get ahead unless you attend every lecture and write every paper - there's no respect for passion!

transcript.speaker: Trisha Miller
transcript.text: Some of these kids, they just don't understand what Vault-Tec means! Meanwhile, I have to take my third run at a senior thesis. Should be entertaining to get rejected by Dean Elliot again.

transcript.speaker: Trisha Miller
transcript.text: Anyways, cash is tight so I'm gonna take part in hopefully my last thesis project in the sim vault. This kid seems fine and his experiment is about food, so I get to eat well at least.

items.name: Medical Training Development Terminal
items.lead: A terminal you can read in the world.

entries.title: Introduction
entries.text:
A Vault Overseer is responsible for taking on many roles: administrator, adjudicator, spiritual leader, and sometimes, doctor. This course is specifically focused on the latter, teaching students how to diagnose and treat most medical emergencies. 

This is a highly-intensive course - completion of the Vault Health & Well-Being course syllabus is required.

entries.title: VTU-VMT101
entries.text:
VTU-VMT101 - Introduction to Medical Diagnoses

The first step in tackling a medical issue is through proper diagnosis. This course will instruct students on how to use a Vault's medical equipment and facilities to identify and categorize medical issues. 

This intensive, three-month course culminates in a weekend-long residency at the AVR Medical Center in Appalachia where you will assist actual doctors in their diagnoses of emergency room patients.

entries.title: VTU-VMT201
entries.text:
VTU-VMT201 - Skin Disorders and You

Is it acne or is it flesh-eating bacterium? There are literally thousands of potential issues that can affect the skin of the typical Vault dweller. This course will teach proper identification techniques and suggested treatments of skin disorders. 

The course's final exam will involve a blindfolded "Touch and Taste" test since it's highly possible an Overseer may have to diagnose and administer these treatments in the dark.

entries.title: VTU-VMT290
entries.text:
VTU-VMT290 - Limb Replacements: A Primer

Did you know that the second most likely medical hazard in a Vault involves the total loss of a dweller's limb? This course will instruct students on how to properly re-attach severed limbs as well as how to create substitute limbs from household items. 

We'll also teach students advanced techniques such as: substituting arms in place of legs, limb donation screening and experimental lab-grown limb technology.

entries.title: VTU-VMT402
entries.text:
VTU-VMT402 - Advanced Surgical Techniques

This course will fully certify students to perform complex surgical procedures such as: organ transplants, tumor removal and mutation extractions. 

Normally, studying to be a surgical doctor can take as long as eight to ten years. Using Vault-Tec's patented SpeedTeach(tm) system, we'll reduce that study time to only three months. 

Important: registering for this course requires all students to purchase a Vault-Tec Malpractice Protection Certificate (Form VT-MPC45071245C/8) which is available in the bursar's office.

items.name: Overseer's Log
items.lead: A terminal you can read in the world.

entries.text:
[Overseer's Log: 10-15-2077]

T-minus one day until my test run starts! I did the final walkthrough with my advisors before getting locked in. The students will be here tommorow to test my hypothesis that using a calorically dense food paste of my own formulation is superior to standard supplies, and that my flavoring system will create enough variety so that dwellers won't get bored.

[Overseer's Log: 10-16-2077]

My dwellers have arrived! After a brief orientation, I've given them time to adjust to one another, the parameters of the experiment and their respective roles. I plan on giving an address later today.

[Overseer's Log: 10-17-2077]

We are on full lockdown and everything is running smoothly. Unless I signal to my advisors, we're in this until the time locks release 4 weeks from now.  So far, the test is going well and feedback has been positive on the food paste forumlation.

[Overseer's Log: 10-19-2077]

The dwellers are eating even less of the experimental formulation than I expected. They report full bellies and satisfactory metabolisms.

[Overseer's Log: 10-23-2077]

It felt like something happened on the outside today. Almost like an earthquake, and we lost power in the vault temporarily. The dwellers were able to quickly restore power via the backup generators. I assume that this is part of a drill, and my people performed admirably.

[Overseer's Log: 10-26-2077]

A heart attack. Sudden and out of nowhere, one of the maintenance staff died in the middle of his work day.  I'm waiting on the coroner's report before I make any decisions.

[Overseer's Log: 10-27-2077]

The coroner did a full autopsy. It looks like it wasn't a heart attack, but the arterial walls of the heart hardened and cracked. I've ordered a medical review of the control group and members of the test group.

[Overseer's Log: 10-28-2077]

It's conclusive - my food paste formulation causes arterial plaque buildup. There were no signs of buildup in the control group, so I've ordered the dwellers to take stock of the remaining standard issue food to see if we have another week left in us.

[Overseer's Log: 10-29-2077]

More bad news. My food paste was not as popular as I thought. Apparently a black market for standard rations cropped up and we only have rations for 2 days for everyone in the vault. I want to try and devise a solution to this problem before I signal my advisors to end the test prematurely. This is my Senior Thesis Experiment and if I fail, I won't be able to operate as a full overseer.

[Overseer's Log: 10-31-2077]

The dwellers are threatening to revolt if I don't call the experiment. They burned through the rations quicker than we thought and are now getting scared. I'm going to signal my advisor and cancel the test.  I can't take the chance that we're going to lose anyone else.

[Overseer's Log: 11-01-2077]

No response from the outside. The dwellers think that I'm lying to them and are threatening to storm my office. I'm not sure if I can hold off a full offensive for 2 full weeks.

[Overseer's Log: 11-02-2077]

They've breached the outer seal and are at the door to my office. I can hear the drill operating. It'll take them days to get through but I can't take the chance. I don't know why my advisors aren't responding. People are dying here and more are going to die and there's nothing I can do about it. This will be my final entry before I barricade myself in my bedroom in the hopes that I can outlast the timed locks. God willing this is just part of the test.  Something tells me it's not.

items.name: Physical Health Development Terminal
items.lead: A terminal you can read in the world.

entries.title: Introduction
entries.text: One of the primary concerns for a Vault Overseer is the health & well-being of the Vault's population. Through this course, Vault-Tec will instruct you on how to monitor, diagnose and treat various health-related issues that can arise in one of our Vaults. If you have any questions about the entries in this syllabus, please speak to a Vault-Tec University representative.

entries.title: VTU-HWB101
entries.text:
VTU-HWB101 - Introduction to Dweller Health

This course is designed to introduce the physical aspects of Vault dweller health and survival. The Vault Overseer will learn what makes their dwellers tick, what can potentially go wrong and how to implement health and well-being solutions.

As a bonus, you'll spend a weekend in one of our Test Vaults and experience the effects that recirculated air, recirculated water and mild doses of radiation can have on the human body.

entries.title: VTU-HWB201
entries.text:
VTU-HWB201 - Introduction to Contaminants

The average Vault contains approximately 673 possible contaminants. This course will introduce the Vault Overseer to what we refer to as the "TTC List," or Top Ten Contaminants List. We'll cover the sources of these contaminants, their effect on the human body and how to treat health issues that will arise from exposure. 

Finally, if your Vault has been certified as an Observation Vault, the course will also cover how to introduce these contaminants at low enough levels to gather proper data points without long-term harmful effects.

entries.title: VTU-HWB304
entries.text:
VTU-HWB304 - Organic Recycling

All Vaults are designed to be completely self-reliant and are equipped with the proper amount of food and water before they are sealed. In the unlikely event that one of these systems fails, or if said supplies are improperly distributed or lost, the Vault Overseer will have to implement Organic Recycling Procedures. 

This course will cover use and maintenance of a Vault's Waste Recycling Systems and how to properly administer food and drink. The highlight of the course is our Week-Long Waste Sprint where students are forced to survive using our sample recycling systems and their own waste.

entries.title: VTU-HWB410
entries.text:
VTU-HWB410 - Survival Through Cannibalism

This is an advanced study course that deals with the possibility that a Vault can reach "LAFFS Status" (Lack of All Food and Food-Like Sources). When food supplies are completely exhausted, and the Vault's recycling systems are offline, Vault-Tec has given all Overseers permission to use any means necessary to ensure dweller survival. To achieve this goal, cannibalism may become necessary. 

This course will cover all aspects of cannibalism, including: moral ramifications, corpse consumption safety and how to make delicious side-dishes using only hair and toenails.
